trials.title: Monitoring Environmental Exposures and Behavioral Change
trials.note: Status moved to COMPLETED in this window. Real-time personal exposure feedback as the intervention itself, n=30 — the same behaviour-change axis as NCT05160948 but with a live feedback loop rather than a post-hoc report. Directly relevant to distributed low-cost PM sensing: it tests whether the display, not the measurement, is what changes exposure. n=30 is far too small for a behavioural endpoint and there is no sham-display arm, so any effect is confounded with participation.

trials.title: Reducing Respiratory Virus Transmission in Bangladeshi Classrooms
interventions: Combined: Box Fan and UV Germicidal Irradiation Lamp Units
trials.note: WITHDRAWN at enrollment 0, no reason posted. Box-fan (Corsi-Rosenthal-class) and UVGI arms in low-resource classrooms; the endpoint was viral transmission, not PM, but it is the only registered trial of DIY filtration at classroom scale this watch has tracked. Its withdrawal removes the one prospective test of whether cheap box-fan units deliver measurable benefit in the settings that most need them.

trials.title: Savannah Environmental Nutrition Study (SENS) Food as Prevention: A Community-Based Nutrition Intervention to Reduce Air Pollution-Related Inflammation and Oxidative Stress in Residents Near the Port of Savannah
interventions: Antioxidant- and Nutrient-Rich Food-Based Nutrition Intervention

primary: Participant retention rate (>=80% target), baseline to week 12
secondary: Change in exhaled-breath-condensate H2O2 (uM, Amplex Red)
Change in systolic and diastolic BP

trials.note: Feasibility trial; primary endpoint is retention, not a health outcome. FeNO and EBC H2O2 are the airway-inflammation and oxidative-stress markers. No PM exposure measurement is registered - proximity to the Port of Savannah is the exposure proxy.

NCT07271381.title: THREAT: Testing Harms Related to Exposure to Allergenic and Epithelial Toxins
NCT07271381.sponsor: National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID)
primary_outcomes: Cohort 1 (skin): The primary endpoint for the skin substudy is the skin impedance change response from the common environment.

Cohort 2 (GI): The primary endpoint for the GI substudy is analogous to that of the skin substudy, except replacing skin impedance with the Shannon-Weaver diversity index measured on the gut microbiome that measures metabolic diversity.
Cohort 2 (Airway): The primary endpoint for the airway substudy is the airway maximum change response from the common environment minus the airway maximum change response from the pure environment.
Based on combined exposures from all 3 organ systems and randomization design, repeat primary and secondary endpoint responses of Stage 1.
